detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no package.json, this is not a JavaScript or TypeScript project" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned range no longer resolves in the manager the lockfile names

packageManagerAdditions.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
declared="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[^"]*"//p' package.json | cut -d@ -f1 | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$declared" ] && [ "$declared" != "$pm" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json names $declared, the lockfile names $pm" >&2
  exit 78
fi
ver="$(node -v 2>/dev/null)" || ver=""
major="${ver#v}"
major="${major%%.*}"
case "$major" in "" | *[!0-9]*) major=0 ;; esac
if [ "$major" -lt 20 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: this recipe needs Node 20 or newer, the host reports major $major" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if ! grep -q '"vitest"' package.json; then
  echo "nightshift: coverage needs the vitest runner in package.json, provision test execution first" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -z "$(find . -name node_modules -prune -o -name .git -prune -o -name '*.test.*' -print -o -name '*.spec.*' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: coverage unavailable, no test files found" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm install --save-dev "@vitest/coverage-v8@^3.2.0"; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm add --save-dev "@vitest/coverage-v8@^3.2.0"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn add --dev "@vitest/coverage-v8@^3.2.0"; fi

probe.command:
for f in vitest.coverage.config.mjs .c8rc .c8rc.json .nycrc .nycrc.json .nycrc.yml; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi
done
if grep -qE '"(@vitest/coverage-v8|@vitest/coverage-istanbul|c8|nyc|jest)"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
exit 1

rollback.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm uninstall @vitest/coverage-v8
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm remove @vitest/coverage-v8
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn remove @vitest/coverage-v8
fi

smoke.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm exec --no -- vitest run --coverage --config vitest.coverage.config.mjs
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm exec vitest run --coverage --config vitest.coverage.config.mjs
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn run vitest run --coverage --config vitest.coverage.config.mjs
else
  echo "nightshift: no lockfile, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
